tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal nag po chen po phyag drug pa'i gtor bsngo bsdus pa bzhugs so// gu ru ma hā kā la ye/ mgon po phyag drug pa'i mchod gtor mgyogs myur 'khyer bde la/ mchod gtor ci 'byor pa lag len ltar bshams/ bdag bskyed bla med kyi yi dam gang rung byas la/ gtor ma nang mchod chu chang sogs kyi stabs 'grig na sbyangs/ ma 'grig na chu gtsang gis bran/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum sogs kyis byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod shing tsan dan rkang gcig gi drung nas dpal nag po chen pa phyag drug pa 'khor dang bcas pa/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥrten yod na/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas bstim/ med na 'di mi dgos/ de nas chos skyong 'khor bcas kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / shā sa na lan gsum mam lnga'am/ bdun sogs kyis phul/ oṃ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul yid la gang 'dod kyi 'dod don la gsol ba btab/ rdo dril 'dzin pas/ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gis spyan snga ru/ /chos bzhin zhes sogs/ bstod pa gang shes kyis bstod/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na mi dgos mi dmigs par bzhag pas chog go /zhes pa 'di'ang buddha lakṣ+mīs bgyis pa'o/ /sarba maṅgā laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ dpal nag po chen po phyag drug pa'i gtor bsngo bsdus pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
